title: IPI by Item (5 digit)
description: Real output of the three main industrial sectors by MSIC item (5 digit). The table provides a preview of the full dataset using the latest month of data only.

fields.title: Series Type
fields.description: [String] Series type, either absolute values ('abs'), year-on-year growth ('growth_yoy') or month-on-month growth ('growth_mom')

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with DD set to 01 as the data is at monthly frequency

fields.title: Item
fields.description: [String] 5-digit code, to be matched using the 'item' column in the [MSIC Lookup](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/msic). The MSIC lookup table will give you the English and Malay definitions.

fields.name: index
fields.title: Index
fields.description: [Float] Quantity of output expressed as an index with base 2015 = 100

methodology:
The Industrial Production Index (IPI) is designed to measure the production of industrial commodities in the mining, manufacturing, and electricity sectors in real terms (i.e. in terms of output, not sales value). The IPI is produced using the following data:
 - Monthly data on the production of crude oil and natural gas from PETRONAS.
 - Monthly production data for 245 selected industries in the manufacturing sector from the Monthly Manufacturing Survey, which covers establishments with significant sales.
 - Monthly data on the production of crude palm oil, refined palm kernel oil and palm kernel oil from the Malaysian Palm Oil Board (MPOB).
 - Monthly data on the generation of electricity from Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB), Sabah Electricity Sdn. Bhd. (SESB) and Sarawak Energy Berhad (SEB).

 For a full description of the methodology, please refer to the [Technical Notes](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/technical-notes/ipi-technotes).
caveat:
Seasonally adjusted data (for all items) and data for items in the electricity section (D, 35101 to 35303) is not provided at 5 digit granularity. Furthermore:
 - Although the mining section (B) contains 56 items, only data for crude oil and natural gas (06101 and 06201) is provided here, because computation of the IPI does not include the other items.
 - The manufacturing section (C) contains 259 items. However, only data for 130 items (representing ~91% of the weightage of the manufacturing section) is provided. This means that higher-level indices (e.g. overall IPI) cannot be derived from this 5 digit dataset.
 - Data for items 11010, 11020 and 11030 are subsumed under item 11010; data for items 24201, 24202 and 24209 are subsumed under item 24201. This is due to a high margin of error when those items are disaggregated.
publication: [Index of Industrial Production, May 2026](https://open.dosm.gov.my/publications/ipi_2026-05), the latest edition of the monthly industrial production statistics published by DOSM. OpenDOSM also features a [dashboard on industrial production](https://open.dosm.gov.my/dashboard/industrial-production).
